requirements.title: Nominal measurement acceptance
requirements.statement: The controller shall accept a sensor measurement when its value is within the configured operating range and its timestamp is current.
requirements.acceptance_criteria: The measurement is marked valid and the controller remains in the monitoring state.

requirements.title: Out-of-range detection
requirements.statement: The controller shall identify a measurement that falls outside the configured operating range.
requirements.acceptance_criteria: A range fault is recorded and the invalid measurement is not used as a valid controller input.

requirements.title: Rate-of-change detection
requirements.statement: The controller shall identify a measurement whose change from the previous valid measurement exceeds the configured rate limit.
requirements.acceptance_criteria: A rate fault is recorded and the measurement is classified as invalid.

requirements.title: Stale-data detection
requirements.statement: The controller shall identify a measurement whose age exceeds the configured stale-data limit.
requirements.acceptance_criteria: A stale-data fault is recorded and the controller does not treat the measurement as current.

requirements.title: Missing-update detection
requirements.statement: The controller shall detect when no sensor update is received within the configured watchdog interval.
requirements.acceptance_criteria: A watchdog fault is recorded after the allowed interval is exceeded.

requirements.title: Safe-state transition
requirements.statement: The controller shall enter the safe state when a critical fault is detected.
requirements.acceptance_criteria: The controller state changes to safe and the triggering fault remains available for review.

requirements.title: Fault latching
requirements.statement: The controller shall retain a critical fault until an explicit reset is requested after valid recovery conditions are met.
requirements.acceptance_criteria: The fault remains active across later processing cycles until a permitted reset occurs.

requirements.title: Controlled recovery
requirements.statement: The controller shall leave the safe state only after an explicit reset and receipt of a valid current measurement.
requirements.acceptance_criteria: A reset without valid recovery evidence is rejected; a reset with valid evidence returns the controller to monitoring.

requirements.title: Deterministic behavior
requirements.statement: The controller shall produce the same states and fault records when given the same ordered input sequence and configuration.
requirements.acceptance_criteria: Repeated executions produce identical controller results.

requirements.title: Traceable output
requirements.statement: The controller evaluation shall connect each verification case to a requirement and recorded outcome.
requirements.acceptance_criteria: Every requirement has at least one linked verification case and a documented result.
